title: Provision of Heritage type Streetlights and Landscaping Lights for Tourism at Minicoy (S) Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for providing heritage-style street lights and landscaping lights for tourism at Minicoy (South) Lighthouse, Lakshadweep, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Minicoy (S) Lighthouse
sites.work: Heritage type street lights and landscaping lights for tourism

scope.item: Provision of Heritage type Streetlights and Landscaping Lights for Tourism

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; to be submitted one day before last day of bid submission (17.02.2025 15:00). Small scale industries with valid NSIC/MSME certificate exempted from EMD. Tender fee mentioned in EMD row heading but no amount printed.

eligibility: Bids invited from reputed OEMs or their authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: Short 2-page NIT only; no completion period, bid validity, detailed eligibility, BOQ or specifications. Download/bid submission 04.02.2025 09:00 to 18.02.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 19.02.2025 16:00.
